Authorized now: persistence of this exact policy, bounded implementation, forensic investigation, tests, migration dry-run, Issue #205 and PR #206 updates. No historical bulk deletion, CURRENT promotion, substitute Candidate, archive repair in place or Quality Gate bypass is inferred.

## PRODUCT_OWNER_RETENTION_DECISION — implementation, forensics and historical dry-run

Accepted authority: [owner decision](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/205#issuecomment-5917563905). Work strictly remains in Issue #205 / PR #206. New source: `0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c`.

**Policy adoption complete. Bounded implementation reviewed and published. Historical cleanup and deployment not performed.** No Candidate/archive/runtime was deleted in this stage; CURRENT and historical governance records are unchanged. No promotion, native Candidate build, source-product change or Quality Gate bypass occurred. Minecraft/user data are outside this scope and untouched.

### Implementation and evidence

8 full copies and 20 GiB charged archive allocation both apply; 15 GiB must remain after planned/live reservations. Unknown legacy allocation counts. Atomic user-wide slots and volume reservations guard all full builder calls; native output must be fresh and owned, never a retained app. Publisher ownership is bound to run/stage inode and exact identities/receipts. Existing common supervision is reused for completion/failure/signals/crash/stale recovery; future owned retention cleanup adds durable PREPARED/DELETING package transactions and conservative recovery, with fresh canonical authority/integrity at each withdrawal/resumption boundary. Exact full packages are reused across registered roots. No global tmp glob deletion or automatic historical ownership adoption is provided.

Canonical protection captures immutable main CURRENT plus exhaustive open PR heads/proposals, not a caller-provided incomplete list. Conflicting identity tuples, missing canonical pins/survivors, active/foreign/unowned/unknown bytes fail closed. See:

- [Implementation and complete 33-copy inventory](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/ISSUE_205_BOUNDED_RETENTION_IMPLEMENTATION.md)

# Integra: план доведения до полного рабочего macOS-приложения

Основание: прямое поручение владельца 2026-09-13 и повторный аудит
`INTEGRA_AUDIT_REVIEW_2026-09-13.md`. Это план исполнения, не утверждение
готовности и не изменение Product Rules. Исторический READY_APP_V1 — baseline,
не синоним выполнения всего перечисленного ниже. Расширения не исключаются
из конечного результата только потому, что ранее были отложены.

## Актуальный приоритет владельца: 2026-09-25

Эта запись уточняет порядок работ; датированные разделы ниже сохраняются как
история. Полная цель Integra не переносится в videotext. Integra остаётся
основой приложения, а проверенные возможности VideoText переиспользуются через
ограниченные адаптеры. Для Process действует
[`PROCESS_V1_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`](PROCESS_V1_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md): 47 MUST,
без изменения статусов готовности одной лишь документацией.

1. Завершить Process с русской исходной речью. Полный маршрут английской речи
   ASR/alignment/topics можно достроить следующим шагом; перевод текста,
   выбор языка перевода, переведённый TXT и перевод тем остаются обязательными.
2. После Process приоритетны **документы и Knowledge**, прежде полного Studio.
   Развивать проверяемый маршрут документ → извлечение/OCR → источник с точными
   страницами → смысловая проверка → Knowledge и переход к источнику. Части
   уже существуют, но готовность определяется интеграцией и проверкой через UI.
   Не требуется ждать всех расширений OCR перед полезной интеграцией Knowledge.
3. Затем расширять Studio, Publishing, Learning/Marketing/Assistant и остальные
   предусмотренные блоки. Конечный scope не сокращается до обработки видео;
   принятие знаний и реальные внешние публикации сохраняют отдельные полномочия.

Для смены исполнителя Process использовать
[`PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROOF_GATE.md`](PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROOF_GATE.md)
и [#187](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/187). VideoText 0.6.8,
`c4d851c9b39b2aeb696a12aa357d1ae0df350cd3`, является предлагаемой основой
доказательства, не установленным pin Integra. Новые fuzzy-проверки не доказывают
эквивалентность protective retry. PR #183 и #186 рассматриваются как существующие
заготовки lifecycle и перевода с отдельной проверкой, не как уже принятые функции.
SeminarText не удаляется до технического доказательства и отдельного решения
владельца. Эта актуализация не меняет CURRENT, Candidate, component pins или
установленную сборку.

## Критерий завершённой функции

### Уточнение после критического анализа плана

Для #187 действует единая последовательность из Process DoD, раздел E, и
VideoText-only proof plan. Сначала ограниченный этап A проверяет пригодность
VideoText, затем этап B завершает интеграцию и все 47 MUST. Это не две версии
продуктового scope: успешный эксперимент не означает завершённый Process,
замену установленного приложения или право удалить SeminarText.

До первого эксперимента фиксируются контракт результата, минимальные реальные
зависимости, владелец и бюджет retry, контрольные входы и критерии сравнения.
Первый прогон создаёт новые результаты в изолированном проекте без кэша
расшифровки; второй проверяет reuse. Безопасный отказ и успешное восстановление
речи оцениваются отдельно. После конечного набора проверок и ограниченного
цикла исправления принимается техническое решение о переходе к этапу B либо
выдаётся конкретный блокер. Бесконечная настройка моделей не является этапом.

### Первый результат Documents → Knowledge

Следующий после Process ограниченный пакет должен определить один пригодный
сквозной путь, не требуя завершения всего BookText, OCR или Knowledge Studio.
Предлагаемый первый контрольный формат: текстовый PDF с читаемым текстовым
слоем и исходными номерами страниц. Это план первого пакета, не объявление
готовности и не исключение остальных форматов из конечного продукта.

| Часть | Результат и проверка | Не является предварительным условием |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Документный результат | Разрешённый документ импортирован без изменения оригинала; извлечённый текст связан с hash/revision и точными страницами; пропущенные/нечитаемые страницы явно отмечены. Повторное открытие не запускает извлечение заново. | Все форматы, полный OCR, семантическое оглавление, полное Knowledge. Скан вместо текстового PDF должен честно показать необходимость OCR, а не ложную полноту. |
| Проверяемый фрагмент | Пользователь выбирает фрагмент и видит источник/страницу. Машинное предложение остаётся provisional; ручное решение хранится отдельно от исходного текста. | Полный граф понятий, массовое междокументное сопоставление, Studio. |
| Knowledge и обратный переход | Через поддержанный контракт явного human review создаётся запись Knowledge с точной ссылкой на источник; сохранить → закрыть → открыть сохраняет решение и переход на страницу. Изменение исходной revision не переносит принятие молча. | Публикация, Assistant, все операции Knowledge. |

Перед реализацией проверить существующий Evidence/Knowledge путь и его
ограничение reviewed fragments V2 → Canonical Knowledge. Нельзя получить
каноническую запись переименованием provisional-фрагмента. Если существующий
контракт не поддерживает переход, выделить ограниченную интеграционную задачу;
изменение правил смыслового принятия требует отдельного решения владельца.
Формат, разрешённый пример и набор операций фиксируются в следующем bounded
Issue до начала работы. Разработка технического пути не даёт агенту права
принимать реальные знания от имени пользователя.

Порядок для этого пакета: документный результат → поддержанный review →
Knowledge → повторное открытие и точный переход к источнику. Историческая
зависимость всего P7 от всего P4 в таблице ниже не применяется к этому пути.
Documents/Knowledge остаются после Process и до полного Studio; менять этот
приоритет или сокращать Process для ускорения без решения владельца нельзя.

### Проверка каждой функции

Для каждой функции обязательна запись: требование и тип источника → владелец
компонента → production entrypoint → действие native UI → зависимости →
реальные выходные файлы → автоматические проверки → smoke из конкретного
пакета → commit/manifest → ограничения. Отдельные статусы: backend, UI,
проверка пакета, установка пользователю. Нельзя заменять их одним PASS suite.
Неготовые действия disabled с точной подписью «В разработке».

Основной маршрут: источники → определение возможностей → «Что нужно получить?»
→ выбор результатов → автоматические зависимости → план → «Выполнить» →
реальная обработка → необходимая смысловая проверка → результаты и действия.
SeminarText, VideoText и BookText остаются внутренними pinned-компонентами.

## Порядок и критерии завершения

Таблица P0–P12 ниже сохраняет исторический охват и зависимости плана 13 сентября,
а не задаёт текущую очередь исполнения. Для Process действуют DoD §E и
двухэтапный proof plan; для следующего Documents/Knowledge пакета действует
описанный выше сквозной путь. Остальные конечные функции не исключаются.

| Блок | Результат для пользователя | Критерий приёмки и зависимости |
|---|---|---|
| P0. Доставить текущую интеграцию #129 | Машинный текст продолжает обработку без обязательной полной ручной проверки; реальные VideoText операции; выбор страниц OCR | Проверка трёх путей из собранного пакета, real OCR выбранных страниц, сохранение provenance, отсутствие auto-accept; исправление topics+burn; focused/full tests, build, независимый review. При частичном покрытии широкого #129 issue не закрывается |
| P1. Надёжное выполнение | Понятный текущий этап, отмена, закрытие приложения, повтор/восстановление, история без ложного успеха | Комбинации outputs, зависшие/завершённые процессы, restart/offline, сохраняемые ошибки; reuse по source/model/config hash без ненужной повторной ASR; отмена не оставляет работающих потомков |
| P2. Текст и перевод | Читаемые TXT, SRT, выбор языка перевода, исходный и производный текст, качество расшифровки | Реальные SeminarText ASR и VideoText SRT/translation; шум/тишина/паузы/повторы на разрешённых примерах; отсутствие пустого success; JSON остаётся служебным, не единственным результатом; P1 |
| P3. Темы и проверка | Детальность, просмотр/прослушивание, ACCEPT/REJECT/RENAME/SPLIT/MERGE/DEFER, границы и цитаты | Все доступные операции вызывают поддержанный source review; исправления не уничтожают исходные слова; неподдержанная иерархия отдельно, не имитируется плоскими темами; P0–P2 |
| P4. Знания и сквозная навигация | Рабочий Knowledge Studio: знания, понятия, связи, изменения и точный переход к источнику | Source→Topics→Review→Knowledge→цитата/таймкод/страница пройден через UI; стабильные идентификаторы, V1/V2 ограничения явные, нет автоматического принятия или слияния понятий; P3 |
| P5. Проекты и несколько источников | Импорт SeminarText/VideoText, несколько документов/видео в проекте, плейлист с последующей обработкой | Dry-run/copy-on-write/rollback, оригиналы неизменны; checkpoint каждого видео; граф соответствий с отдельными доказательствами и provisional статусом; P1, P4 |
| P6. Полный Media Studio | Клипы по времени/теме/цитате, burn, скорость и соответствующий SRT, blur/watermark, filler review/mute, dubbing/TTS, dereverb | Каждая операция через реальный VideoText adapter, preview параметров, проверенный выход, отмена и provenance; нужные модели проходят preflight; P1–P4 |
| P7. Документы и BookText | PDF/DOCX/PPTX/MD, изображения/сканы, DjVu, книга из изображений, страницы/регионы, иллюстрации и описания | Реальная обработка поддержанных форматов, точные исходные номера страниц/геометрия, явные QA/PDF ошибки и идентичность OCR; семантическое оглавление отдельной реализацией, не подмена extraction; P0, P1, P4 |
| P8. Publishing Hub | Единый выбор TXT/MD/DOCX/PDF/SRT/аудио/видео, Obsidian и файловый OneDrive | Читаемые реальные файлы, preview, hashes, atomic promotion, коллизии/отмена/offline/recovery; локальная запись не называется подтверждённой загрузкой в облако; P2, P4, P6, P7 |
| P9. Marketing и Learning | Реальные материалы из выбранных проверяемых источников и проектных шаблонов | Реализация по #17/#18, каждый материал с provenance и редактированием, без выдуманного backend; P4, P8 |
| P10. Knowledge Assistant | Поиск и ответы по выбранной базе с проверяемыми ссылками | Реализация #19: источники/права/актуальность, точные цитаты, отказ при отсутствии оснований; не unrestricted RAG и не автоматическое изменение знаний; P4, P5 |
| P11. Социальные интеграции | Подготовка и управляемая отправка поддержанных форматов | #20–27, только официальные API; preflight, idempotency, ambiguous-result handling, защищённое хранение токенов. Реальная отправка/аккаунты требуют точного разрешения; контрактные тесты не считаются live-проверкой; P8, P9 |
| P12. Финальная проверка приложения | Одна воспроизводимая установленная сборка, инструкция, диагностика зависимостей и rollback | Полная матрица native E2E на разрешённых примерах, все обязательные проверки PASS, привязка к commit/пакету, проверка установки и ограничений; public signing/notarization отдельно. P0–P11; внешне заблокированные строки явно не завершены |

P12-проверки выполняются после каждого доставляемого блока, а не впервые
в конце. Ранее работающие пути не переписываются ради единообразия: сначала
проверяются и переиспользуются. Внутри блоков — ограниченные Issues/PR,
один владелец записи файла, независимый QA/review по риску.

## Цикл доставки

Текущее main/Issue → ограниченная ветка → implementation + regression →
governance validator + focused/full suite + macOS build/smoke → diff/review →
commit/push/PR → успешный CI и mergeability → безопасный merge → проверка main
→ известная обратимая установка с backup → проверка установленного пакета →
следующий блок. Существующие незакоммиченные изменения не теряются.

Один удачный runtime smoke не считается native UI smoke. Число тестов не
является критерием приёмки. Свидетельства фиксируются с датой и уровнем:
STATIC / UNIT / REAL_COMPONENT / BUNDLE / NATIVE_UI / INSTALLED.

## Уточнения и границы

Для начала P0 уточнения не нужны: scope и порядок определены фактами.
Работа для личного использования на macOS, без изменения source-репозиториев.
Не выполняются автоматически работа с новыми приватными данными/аккаунтами,
платежи, реальные социальные публикации, принятие знаний, уничтожение данных
или публичный release. Эти зависимости не маскируются заглушками и не
останавливают независимые технические блоки. Неизвестные API-возможности
проверяются перед реализацией; неподдерживаемое платформой не обещается.

Доставка P0: первая часть влита через [PR #131](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/pull/131),
merge `a903b7976b194a7e430bd70bcc2c7e1699d13f5d`. 590 локальных тестов без
пропусков, чистая сборка, real-component и native-media smoke прошли.
Это не закрывает весь #129 и не означает автоматического обновления установленной версии.
Установка первой части и исправления закрытия подтверждена после PR #132:
`6831887c8067df41ca8b624d1e00430d12879d7d`, 606 тестов PASS, native и
трёхкомпонентная проверка установленного пакета PASS. Свидетельство установки:
https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/pull/132#issuecomment-5655958350.
P1 IN_PROGRESS; P2–P12 PLANNED (части уже существуют, проверка определяет остаток).

Первый ограниченный пункт P1 зарегистрирован как
[#130](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/130): дождаться отмены активной
обработки перед завершением native-приложения. Остальные пункты P1 не считаются
выполненными при закрытии только этой задачи.
Этот пункт закрыт через PR #132. Следующий ограниченный пункт P1 —
[#133](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/133): повторно использовать
проверенную расшифровку после ошибки последующего этапа без ненужного ASR.

## Актуализация 2026-09-14

Повторно проверены локальные HEAD/working tree и GitHub: PR #134 MERGED,
merge `516dd9db42911a2406d93ba9036743d5d67a00d6`. Поэтому #133 не следует
планировать повторно. Результаты прежних прогонов остаются историческими
доказательствами, а не новым прогоном этой актуализации.

Ближайшая последовательность внутри P1:

1. **#135 — экран обработки и нативные команды.** Устранить пересоздание
   экрана при каждом опросе, убрать немеренные проценты, выполнять чтение
   статуса и отмену вне UI-потока. Защитить навигацию от запоздалых ответов,
   показать реальные ошибки, исключить повторную отмену. Добавить стандартные
   меню macOS и проверить Cmd+Q через существующий безопасный shutdown.
   Предварительная матрица: `ISSUE_135_OPERATIONS_UI.md`.
2. **Восстановление после перезапуска/сбоя.** Сопоставлять сохранённое задание
   с доказанно принадлежащим ему процессом; не объявлять успех или отмену
   без подтверждения. Проверить зависание, аварийное завершение и повтор.
3. **Локальная сохранённая копия источника.** Проверить возможность повтора,
   когда исходный файл OneDrive недоступен, но проект содержит неизменную
   проверяемую копию. При несовпадении хеша — понятная ошибка, не подмена.
4. **Отмена отдельных длительных операций.** Проверить операции вне основного
   source-first run; закрытие не должно оставлять дочерние процессы или
   блокировать интерфейс. Не ослаблять проверку принадлежности процессов.
5. Затем P2 → P3 → P4: читаемые результаты и перевод, темы/review,
   Knowledge Studio и сквозная навигация. Остальные блоки — по зависимостям
   основной таблицы, без повторной реализации уже доказанных компонентов.

Для каждого пункта до реализации фиксируются ожидаемые выходы и негативные
сценарии; после — отдельные доказательства runtime, native UI и установленного
пакета. Временная недоступность внешнего API не закрывает соответствующую
функцию и не препятствует независимым блокам.

Уточнения для этих технических шагов не требуются. Приёмка знаний, подключение
новых аккаунтов и реальные публикации остаются отдельными действиями владельца;
это не повод останавливать разработку технически независимых функций.

docs/PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROOF_GAT.body:
# Process v1 — VideoText-only proof gate

**Status:** decision-gate evidence for [Issue #187](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/187).  It is not a scope change, replacement of the Product Definition, or permission to remove SeminarText.

## Purpose

The Product Owner has chosen a proof-first direction: determine whether normal
Process video/audio work can use **VideoText as its only component runtime**,
with Integra retaining its own UI, persistence, recovery and provenance
contracts.  SeminarText remains the current required fallback until the proof
gate is passed and a separate owner decision authorizes removal.

“VideoText-only” means a selected Process execution has no call to a
SeminarText executable or module.  It does **not** mean that a VideoText source
unit test, registry entry, or disabled UI option is proof of user integration.
It concerns the selected Process runtime, not automatic removal of SeminarText
from every Integra bundle or other product domain. The current fallback has a
documented SRT interoperability defect; retaining it is not a claim that every
existing media journey is reliable.

## Owner decisions recorded 2026-09-25

- Continue the full product on **Integra**, reusing verified VideoText engines
  through bounded adapters rather than rebuilding Integra inside VideoText.
- The first completed Process journey is **Russian-speech first**. Complete
  English-speech ASR/alignment/topics may follow as a separate increment.
  Transcript translation, target-language choice, translated TXT and Topic
  translation remain frozen MUST outcomes. RU-to-EN text translation is not
  equivalent to a completed English-source-speech workflow.
- After Process, prioritize **Documents and Knowledge before full Studio**.
  This sets priority, not implementation/semantic acceptance of either domain.
- Plan proof against the reviewed VideoText 0.6.8 source revision recorded in
  the [execution inventory](PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_EXECUTION_INVENTORY.md).
  Do not silently advance the integrated pin or inherit source-product PASS.

These decisions do not change the 47 MUST count or mark any Completion Board
row DONE. PR #188 recorded the initial plan. The owner's subsequent instruction
to correct it after critical review establishes the two-stage sequence below.
Documentation updates reference #187; they do not complete or close it.

## Current factual baseline

In canonical `main` at the start of Issue #187:

* `user_media.run_job` invokes `asr_reuse → seminartext_asr_runtime →`
  SeminarText `project-transcribe` for a transcript.
* The resulting SeminarText SRT is adapted through the VideoText subtitle
  normalizer; this handoff has just failed on an ordinary real-video Integra
  run because the two SRT contracts are not compatible as currently composed.
* Word Timeline is a separate WhisperX adapter and can consume a valid SRT.
* Topic drafts and the accepted Process Topic Review route use SeminarText
  runtime contracts.
* VideoText is already the translation-worker owner and has bundled media
  operations.  Its source ASR, quality/review diagnostics and hybrid Topics
  engines are not the active selected Process owner.
* Integra itself owns source records, selected-output planning, persistence,
  reuse/invalidation, cancellation, timeout, stale-run reconciliation and the
  Process UI.

The three real-video comparison recorded before this gate showed that both
products transcribed all three Russian videos.  VideoText generated numbered
SRT and its topic sets on all three; direct standalone SeminarText
`project-topics` failed on two longer videos.  These observations do not score
ASR accuracy: there is no human reference transcript for the comparison.

## Required transition matrix

The table covers every frozen Process requirement whose current implementation
uses, or is materially dependent on, SeminarText.  Grouping is intentional:
the Completion Board has aggregate rows, and one user journey can satisfy more
than one requirement.

| Frozen Process outcome(s) | Current component path | VideoText/Integra target | Classification | Proof still required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Local video; local audio; automatic TXT; timed SRT | SeminarText `project-transcribe` via `seminartext_asr_runtime` | VideoText `SegmentedWhisperTranscriber` + `SRTService`; Integra persists the existing output contract | `REUSE_VIDEOTEXT` | One VideoText-native Process route on the same three real Russian videos; numbered SRT, readable TXT, hashes and no SeminarText process/module call. |
| Careful ASR mode; source language; ASR settings and diagnostics | SeminarText CLI defaults; controls incomplete | VideoText source language/quality/review diagnostics, exposed only where frozen Process requires them | `REUSE_VIDEOTEXT` | Exact supported controls, recorded selection and an actionable result/diagnostic; no invented “careful” equivalence. |
| Protective retry against contextual/fuzzy Whisper looping | SeminarText `quality_check` + protective retry; bounded trigger/retry/failure proof, not recovery accuracy | Reuse VideoText detection; name exactly one retry owner at the Stage A contract checkpoint | `IMPLEMENT_IN_VIDEOTEXT_OR_INTEGRA` | Distinguish detector accuracy, bounded retry, safe failure and successful recovery using the evidence matrix below. Genuine spoken repetitions must not become a required rejection oracle; no dedup as a substitute for lost speech. |
| Clean TXT; raw/review derivative provenance | SeminarText clean/review derivatives | VideoText transcript plus an Integra-owned, source-linked readable derivative if VideoText has no equivalent | `BOUNDED_ADAPTER` | Defined clean-text contract, source/ASR linkage, and packaged readable result. |
| Word Timeline and timed source navigation | WhisperX adapter consumes SeminarText SRT | Preserve WhisperX as an Integra-owned alignment adapter consuming VideoText numbered SRT | `INTEGRA_OWNED_REUSE` | Same real Russian alignment proof, exact source/SRT hashes and navigation, with no SeminarText dependency. |
| Basic topics/timestamps; topic summary/detail | SeminarText Topic Engine | VideoText `HybridTopicAdapter` / `OllamaTopicProvider` output, mapped to the existing Process draft contract | `REUSE_VIDEOTEXT` | Prove normal-quality default, only selected granularity/language, no draft fallback, source cue IDs/times and `REVIEW_REQUIRED` semantics in a packaged route. |
| Process Topic Review: edit/confirm; save → close → reopen | SeminarText human-review receipt/contracts | Integra-owned Process-human receipt and reviewed-topic precedence, fed by VideoText drafts | `BOUNDED_ADAPTER` | Preserve `PROCESS_HUMAN_TOPIC_REVIEW`, original machine topic provenance and existing accepted rename/reopen behavior; do not create Knowledge/Evidence acceptance. |
| Translation; language choice; readable translated TXT | VideoText translation worker, currently dependent on upstream SRT | Retain VideoText worker and write its readable output through the Process result contract | `REUSE_VIDEOTEXT` | Selected target, valid source SRT, readable result, provenance and real packaged proof.  The existing SeminarText→VideoText SRT mismatch must not be carried forward. |
| Topic translation | No completed packaged journey established by the current translation PR | Translate topic labels/summaries through a bounded adapter; preserve topic IDs, source spans and source revision | `BOUNDED_ADAPTER` | Separate selected-output proof and reopen; transcript translation alone does not satisfy this MUST. Failed validation or retained original text must not be reported as successful translation. |
| Several ordered inputs; partial failure; combined transcript/provenance; multi-source corpus | Integra sequential planner plus SeminarText project corpus/combined-clear capability | Integra remains owner of run-level ordering/failure accounting; implement only the missing combined/corpus composition on VideoText/Integra artifacts | `INTEGRA_OWNED_REUSE` for order/failure; `BOUNDED_ADAPTER` for combined/corpus | Preserve completed peers after a failure; chronological combined result and per-passage provenance.  Do not use a hidden SeminarText project command. |
| Reuse/invalidation; cancel; retry; timeout; stale RUNNING; orphan cleanup; subsequent success | Integra lifecycle plus `asr_reuse` whose transcriber is SeminarText | Preserve lifecycle semantics; replace only the ASR executor under its governed cache identity | `INTEGRA_OWNED_REUSE` | Existing recovery evidence must be rerun only where ASR executor identity changes: reuse, source/model/config invalidation, failure/retry, cancel/timeout and no owned orphan. |
| Unified results; open/export; persistence/reopen; progress/status; selected outputs | Integra UI/application runtime | No component change | `INTEGRA_OWNED_REUSE` | Regression-only proof on the final VideoText-only Candidate. |
| Selected-Capability Runtime Closure | Current cross-cutting blocked Board row | Integra capability/runtime closure, reusing existing planning infrastructure | `IMPLEMENT_IN_VIDEOTEXT_OR_INTEGRA` | Not completed reuse: implement/prove selected dependency resolution across preflight, imports and packaged workers. A VideoText-only selection may not eagerly require SeminarText; missing selected dependencies must be shown before execution with an actionable reason. |

## Execution authority and ordering

For the #187 executor transition, this sequence and DoD section E describe the
same active order. It supersedes the former instruction to finish verification
of the outgoing runtime before investigating the new one. Historical Board
evidence remains unchanged. Missing implementation for a replacement executor
is not automatically a new product requirement: reuse first, then define a
bounded adapter/repair under the existing MUST. New capabilities, source-product
changes or altered semantic/acceptance policy still require exact authority.

Stage A answers whether a bounded VideoText transition is viable. Stage B
finishes and proves all 47 MUST outcomes. Stage A cannot close #187, replace
the user's app, remove SeminarText, or claim full Process acceptance. Select
one next bounded Issue from evidence; this plan does not start implementation.

## Stage A: bounded feasibility proof

1. **Freeze contracts and inputs before adapters.** Record exact commits,
   models/configs, the same three Russian control videos and existing loop
   fixtures. Keep Gold and user projects unchanged. Specify a versioned worker
   result mapping for source identity, TXT/SRT, quality, output hashes, actual
   executor and errors/progress. Integra owns jobs, leases and cancellation;
   name one owner for protective retry and its attempt/time budget to prevent
   nested retry loops. Reuse existing storage; ProcessedSource is a target to
   implement, not an already completed immutable result contract.
2. **Minimum real dependency closure.** Before the first packaged ASR proof,
   specify and test the selected worker's imports, preflight and bundle/runtime
   requirements. No unrelated SeminarText probe or integrity bypass may be
   necessary to execute it. Keep the old route available and preserve its known
   SRT limitation. Review relevant lifecycle work in #183 against this proof's
   needs; do not make completion of every draft change a prerequisite. Record
   exact rollback and owned-process cleanup before expensive runs.
3. **Fresh ASR proof, then reuse.** Reuse VideoText's existing transcriber and
   quality services through the narrow adapter. Each control input first runs
   in an isolated test project with no transcript or result cache: record
   actual VideoText execution, raw numbered SRT/TXT and hash-linked outputs.
   Model/embedding downloads are not transcript caches. No SeminarText calls
   and no pre-existing SeminarText artifacts may satisfy this first proof.
   A separate unchanged-input run must demonstrate valid reuse with no ASR.
   Never delete the user's cache to obtain a cold test.
4. **Bounded topic compatibility probe.** On a fresh, validated transcript,
   map existing HybridTopicAdapter output to Process topics with actual cue
   IDs/times and the normal-quality, selected-only variant. Verify a minimal
   review/save/reopen round trip without losing machine provenance. This
   checks the second replacement boundary; it is not full topic acceptance.
5. **Decision checkpoint.** Before starting runs, record the finite case list,
   maximum retry attempts/time per case, one repair-and-rerun budget and the
   acceptance comparison rules. Exhaustion returns an evidence package, not
   unlimited tuning. Proceed to Stage B only when fresh execution, valid
   output mapping, safe lifecycle and topic compatibility are demonstrated
   and remaining gaps have bounded owners/solutions. A technical pass is
   permission to select the next authorized implementation item, not a new
   mandatory human approval stop. Missing equivalence returns
   `VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROCESS_NOT_YET_PROVEN`; an authority/architecture conflict
   returns `BLOCKED` for the appropriate decision. Do not force the migration.

## Stage B: integration and full Process completion

1. **Implement the result boundary before downstream consumers.** Create the
   minimal immutable ProcessedSource projection over existing artifacts per
   DoD section G, with revision/predecessor and atomic completeness. Do not
   replace the database. Define compatibility for old results explicitly;
   preserve their executor labels and human edits. Invalidation is per derived
   output: changing topic detail/model must not require ASR; changing source
   or transcript revision invalidates dependent topics/alignment/translation,
   retaining old reviewed versions without silently rebasing them.
2. **Integrate ASR, then topics in separate reviewable changes.** Preserve
   Integra Clean TXT derivatives and Russian WhisperX alignment. Prove fresh
   execution and warm reuse, source/model/config invalidation, failure, cancel,
   timeout, reopen and subsequent success. For topics, prove summaries,
   selected detail/language only, no draft fallback, real source spans and
   human edits surviving restart. Apply compatible Gold checks without
   changing Gold or inheriting a different algorithm's PASS. Process review
   does not create Knowledge acceptance.
3. **Finish remaining frozen MUST journeys using existing work.** Review and
   reuse relevant #186 translation implementation; prove Topic translation
   separately. Connect truthful ASR controls, folder/Zoom/playlist preview and
   confirmation, ordered sources, partial failure, combined transcript and
   corpus with per-passage provenance. Never hide a SeminarText corpus call.
   Complete selected dependency closure incrementally with each output,
   rather than postponing its design to final QA.
4. **Full exact-Candidate verification.** Map each of the 47 MUST outcomes to
   its actual native action, produced artifact/state, negative case, test and
   evidence on one packaged Candidate. Repeat two short-video native E2E runs
   on those same bytes for stability, alongside long-media and fault cases;
   these repetitions do not replace the full matrix. Independent QA/review,
   applicable non-skipped runtime proofs, regression and integrity gates must
   pass before user acceptance. Serialize expensive local model/build runs.

Only the whole matrix supports `VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROCESS_PROVEN`. Technical
proof, human `PROCESS V1 USER_ACCEPTED`, runtime promotion and authority to
remove SeminarText remain separate events.

## Evidence and acceptance matrix

Freeze checks before execution, not after seeing output. A proof record binds
input/hash, exact Candidate/runtime/model/config, cold/warm state, expected
outcome, actual result and artifact/log evidence. Numerical semantic/performance
thresholds must be justified from the control material and measured baseline;
none are invented by this documentation update. Unspecified criteria mean
NOT_READY to start the relevant proof, not permission to choose post-hoc limits.

| Evidence | What it proves and required interpretation |
| --- | --- |
| Same three real Russian videos, including long-media/chunk boundaries | Fresh executor integration, numbered valid SRT, preserved source identity and inspected speech coverage. Without a reference transcript report observations, not ASR accuracy percentages. Include short/long and VAD/no-VAD cases where the paths differ; preserve the original controls. |
| Artificial ASR-loop regression | Detector and bounded automatic retry are exercised. A suspicious retry stays failed/review-required as the supported contract specifies; it is never a completed valid transcript. |
| Genuine spoken repetitions | False-positive control: preserve the words. The old repeated-speech fixture proved a trigger/retry/failure path, not that rejecting correct repeated speech is desirable. Record false positives independently; do not turn the old rejection into a mandatory quality oracle. |
| Recoverable failure case | Compare retry output to known source speech and prove recovery separately. Safe failure is not recovery. Do not require every acoustic failure to recover; do not strengthen the historical safety-only Board claim silently. |
| Topic quality | On an authorized compatible reference, fix boundary matching tolerance, missed/spurious-boundary and title/summary review criteria before comparison. Valid JSON/cue IDs prove structure, not semantic quality. No Gold edits or fabricated new reference labels. |
| Model/worker failures | Cover malformed/truncated JSON, unavailability, timeout, cancellation and retry exhaustion. Verify valid upstream artifacts survive and the next run works without restart. |
| Performance | Record cold/warm wall time, time per media minute, peak memory, temporary disk and model request/variant counts on the reference Mac. Define allowed regression limits before running. Only requested topic detail/language executes. |
| Full 47-MUST matrix | Product completeness on the exact packaged Candidate, not inherited component tests or historical DONE counts. |
| Two consecutive short-video native E2E runs | Repeatability of the declared GUI workflow/outputs on the same Candidate; not long-media quality, all MUST outcomes or installation proof. Record actual packaged entrypoint, actions and expected files before running. |

## Explicit non-permission

This gate does not authorize changing Process scope, deleting a SeminarText
pin, retiring historical evidence, starting Knowledge/Studio/BookText, or
claiming `PROCESS V1 USER_ACCEPTED`.

It is blocked by the adopted archive caps and disk reserve in the actual historical state. **Do not merge/promote or infer owner Candidate acceptance from policy adoption.** Earlier successful Quality Gate runs apply to their old exact heads only.

### Historical migration dry-run (no actual cleanup)

Forensics resolved both inventory discrepancies as post-COMPLETE cache additions only; all recorded bytes matched. The existing a6d470/8be1ad recovery alternates freshly fully verify; unverified originals remain quarantined and forbidden for promotion. Writer remains unproven. Before a nonempty historical migration plan can be generated, resolve exact rollback/recovery survivor paths, enumerate active provenance pins (including retained pilot2fe375), resolve missing old pending Candidates, and attest enumerated legacy ownership/terminal disposition. ### Evidence

## Historical PR reports

The reports below are preserved history. Their old policy, head, Candidate and check outcomes do not describe the new source above.

## Latest forensic follow-up — 2026-09-30

Exact source `72fc6d37fede5fa3af7fd16934648b6e90120e85`; evidence overlay `1790a75`; declaration HEAD `073ad80bffe0ee6144bc96cf1a3c13ba606b5ceb`.

### Findings and repair

- Two pressure sources: legacy unowned tmp builds and unbounded permanent Candidate publication under the accepted PR #193 retention contract.

The committed metadata inventory records 26 top-level COMPLETE Candidate archives / 14 bundle digests, plus retained historical Candidates and recovery/runtime/tmp copies; source commits and associated PRs, timestamps, sizes, receipt identities, and representative inode/link counts are recorded. - Four controlled source revisions added ~8.20 GiB logical app bytes (~8.5 GiB allocated) under the existing actual-byte retention requirement. This permanent growth is explicitly accounted for; no retained archive was pruned.
- Last Data free-space measurement: ~16.6 GiB. Earlier whole-volume find PIDs 9241/9275/9276 are no longer present.

`docs/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_AUDIT.md`, `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_20260930.json`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE.json`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json`, `scripts/build_disk_admission.py`, `scripts/candidate_archive.py`, `scripts/temp_workspace_lifecycle.py`, `state/proposed_baseline_lite_v1.json`, `tests/test_build_disk_admission.py`, `tests/test_candidate_archive.py`, `tests/test_temp_workspace_lifecycle.py`.

- `docs/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_AUDIT.md`
- `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md` (follow-up section)
- `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_20260930.json`

## Historical initial repair report

The following text is the earlier snapshot; the follow-up above supersedes its current-state counts, Candidate, checks and process status.

Fixes #205. Related: #181, PR #183, and retained-Candidate policy from merged PR #193.

## Root cause and recurrence

The earlier owned-scratch fix did not cover direct Codex/manual calls to the low-level app builder, which created named `/private/tmp/integra-excel*` full Candidates without lifecycle ownership. PR #183 remains open, and this PR's broader guard was unmerged when the issue recurred. On 2026-09-30, `/private/tmp` occupied 24 GiB and Data had about 18 GiB free. Five stale copies had byte-verified permanent archives and no open users; only those exact five roots were deleted, recovering about 11 GiB. Five other full-size roots remain protected as UNKNOWN or an active PR worktree. The 53 GiB Build Archive at audit time is a separate retained-artifact pressure source; no archive was pruned.

## Repair

- The common disposable-workspace runner now forks a detached supervisor that owns the child process group and workspace. It detects killed/abandoned callers, handles SIGINT/SIGTERM and finite timeout, and removes the workspace on success or failure.
- The full Candidate wrapper uses that same lifecycle and enforces the documented 2.4 GiB expected size plus 2 GiB hard reserve.
- New runs conservatively reap only marked stale work. Live owners, unproven groups, other users' roots, retained archives, and source-product workspaces remain protected.
- Embedded runtime sharing and hard links were not introduced; Candidate and archive byte isolation remains unchanged. No SeminarText, VideoText, or BookText source repository was modified.

## Real macOS evidence

- Two sequential full Candidates, two concurrent full Candidates, failure, timeout, stale/live reaping, and release path all passed. Every scenario left zero owned roots and no owned descendants.
- Free before: 30.53 GB; after scenarios: 29.38 GB. The first build warmed caches; the second sequential build changed free space by only about 4.5 MB. Peak owned temp usage: 4.61 GB during concurrent builds; minimum free: 24.81 GB.
- Focused lifecycle tests: 11 passed. Final full suite: 830 run, 738 passed, 92 skipped, zero failures. Agent-team and `git diff --check`: PASS.

- Governed sequence: source `3ee6365` → evidence `bd5d014`/`438e5d6` → declaration `324f9e9`. Local `scripts/validate_governance.py`: PASS, `CURRENT_VALID`, `PROPOSED_BASELINE_VALID / AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE`.
- Evidence: `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_REPEATED_BUILD_EVIDENCE_20260930.json`, and `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_DISK_PEAK_20260930.json`.

## Remaining gates and limits

GitHub Quality Gate passed on exact head `324f9e9` (run 36730057135). The declared Candidate still awaits Product Owner acceptance under the repository's promotion contract. No CURRENT promotion or automatic release is claimed. The completed archive set (about 53 GiB before the new ~2.1 GiB Candidate) is protected by the accepted retention policy; pruning needs an explicit retention decision. all_pr_summaries.title: Recovery WP: bounded lifecycle recovery from current main
all_pr_summaries.body:
# Recovery WP — current `main`

Status: `BLOCKED` pending current-canonical governance promotion and the
repository GitHub Quality Gate. No owner handoff, merge, or deployment was
performed.

## 1. Starting identity

This worktree was created directly from `main` at
`4f20ed5ad76af164a5561e33510b7d36b903eee8` on branch
`codex/issue-161-recovery-wp`. Historical #137 branches were not used.

The recovery change is one evidence-backed repair cycle. Astra and owner
testing were not used.

## 2. Rebaseline and gap matrix

| Scenario | Current behavior before repair | Required behavior | Evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Worker non-zero failure | `execute_run` persisted `FAILED`; downstream artifacts were not promoted | Truthful terminal failure with stage/reason and no false success | Existing `tests/test_application_runtime.py`, `tests/test_user_media.py`, controlled recovery probe | PASS; preserved |
| Worker timeout | No bounded timeout around the plan worker | Bounded timeout with terminal failure | Pre-repair `test_bounded_plan_timeout_is_enforced` errored (`RunTimedOut` absent) | RED; repaired |
| User cancellation | Existing cancellation marker/process-tree termination persisted `CANCELLED` | Distinct cancellation and no orphan | `tests/test_shutdown_runtime.py`, `tests/test_shutdown_ui.py`, realistic recovery | PASS; preserved |
| Process interruption | Active record could remain `RUNNING` after owner disappeared | Reconcile deterministically on re-entry | Pre-repair `test_stale_running_is_reconciled_without_erasing_completed_upstream` errored (`reconcile_stale_runs` absent) | RED; repaired |
| Stale `RUNNING` at startup | `recent-runs` only enumerated records | Startup/re-entry must terminalize stale ownership | `test_bridge_recent_runs_reconciles_stale_state_on_startup` | RED; repaired |
| Orphan subprocesses | Existing verified process identity/tree freeze-kill cleanup | No live worker after terminalization | `tests/test_shutdown_runtime.py`; clean realistic recovery process snapshot | PASS; preserved |
| Completed upstream artifacts | Existing run records retained completed source results | Preserve immutable upstream while failing downstream | stale reconciliation regression asserts `source_results` preserved | PASS; preserved |
| Governed reuse | Existing exact source/runtime/model/config/hash binding | Reuse only on exact identity | `tests/test_asr_reuse.py` and clean realistic recovery (`asr_reuse.state=CREATED`) | PASS; preserved |
| Invalidation | Existing cache tamper/identity mismatch invalidation | Never reuse changed identity | `tests/test_asr_reuse.py` invalidation cases | PASS; preserved |
| Retry/new run | Existing retry creates a new run and does not relabel old failure | Subsequent run truthful and independently terminal | clean controlled recovery probe and realistic recovery | PASS; preserved |
| False `COMPLETED` | Existing terminal promotion rejects cancelled/failed source results | No partial/false success | `tests/test_application_runtime.py` and packaged probes | PASS; preserved |

## 3. Bounded recovery contract

The repair implements only the missing contract edges:

* `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, and `CANCELLED` remain distinct persisted states;
* `run_with_timeout` bounds the production plan worker (default 1800 seconds,
  configurable only to a finite positive value no greater than 7200 seconds);
* stale active records are reconciled when the bridge re-enters the run
  lifecycle, using verified process identity and preserving completed source
  results;
* explicit cancellation markers reconcile to `CANCELLED`, while an owner that
  disappeared without cancellation reconciles to `FAILED` with a retry-required
  user message;
* existing process-tree cleanup, ASR reuse/invalidation, and retry semantics
  remain unchanged.

## 4. Reproduction and root causes

Before repair, the new production-equivalent regression file
`tests/test_recovery_contract.py` produced three errors: stale reconciliation
was missing, the GUI-facing startup path could only display stale `RUNNING`,
and `RunTimedOut` did not exist. These are lifecycle omissions, not ASR or
component-pin defects.

Root causes:

1. `macos/Resources/bridge.py` had no reconciliation call before
   `run-status`, `recent-runs`, cancel, or retry operations.
2. The `process-plan` bridge operation called `execute_run` without a bounded
   worker timeout.

## 5. Minimal repair and candidate transition

Repair commit: `242e70517bb345e74b84086994639a919daa511a`.

Changed files:

* `integra_core/shutdown_runtime.py` — timeout primitive and stale-run
  reconciliation;
* `macos/Resources/bridge.py` — lifecycle re-entry and bounded plan wrapper;
* `tests/test_recovery_contract.py` — stale, cancellation, timeout, and
  bridge-startup regressions.

No ASR parameters, component pins, SeminarText bytes, VideoText, BookText, or
Integra model semantics were changed.

Final clean candidate built from the repair commit:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Candidate ID | `candidate-v1-ae870cf0394a50f620f564af0812b20ec0ae610bf0a6503d76ef2233ba165c8c` |
| Candidate identity SHA | `ae870cf0394a50f620f564af0812b20ec0ae610bf0a6503d76ef2233ba165c8c` |

| Source commit | `242e70517bb345e74b84086994639a919daa511a` |
| Isolated app | `/private/tmp/integra161-build-clean.UQG4AA/Integra.app` |

Manifest validation and native self-test both passed.

## 6. Lifecycle test matrix

| Gate | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Recovery contract targeted tests | PASS (46 tests, 17 skipped) | `python3 -m unittest tests.test_recovery_contract tests.test_shutdown_runtime tests.test_asr_reuse tests.test_application_runtime` |
| Broader recovery/runtime targeted tests | PASS (106 tests, 25 skipped) | shutdown, ASR reuse, application, user-media, operations, candidate, SeminarText, Word Timeline suites |
| Controlled failure → retry | PASS | `/private/tmp/issue161-recovery-parent.nOxj8I/run/.../word_timeline.worker-evidence.json`; failed `ab1dff77-af8a-42b9-ba22-ecc7b1ffd01a`, completed `aa622231-7236-4756-8b13-c453f7b4818a` |

| Governed reuse/invalidation | PASS | Existing ASR reuse suite and realistic retry evidence |
| Full local unittest suite | 646 run; 641 pass, 73 skipped, 2 unrelated GUI/package errors, 3 governance failures | See §10; no failures were hidden |

## 7. Accepted primary journey regression

Both packaged probes ran through the production bridge in a Finder-like
minimal environment on the same clean candidate:

* deterministic Russian fixture: `COMPLETED`, topics, persistence, navigation,
  Word Timeline and ffmpeg evidence PASS; source SHA
  `db0cbfd61a3861442114d27633d0b8115af792f6532674298886d86fd57cf3e4`;
* realistic natural-Russian fixture: `COMPLETED`, topics, persistence,
  navigation, Word Timeline and ffmpeg evidence PASS; source SHA
  `00270ff4b993a1bdc77304256f7fb6b32fa54afc73c59388561d123830d79c98`.

Evidence roots:

* `/private/tmp/issue161-pack-clean.NxMHW5/det/`;
* `/private/tmp/issue161-pack-clean.NxMHW5/real/`.

Owner-derived Word Timeline regression also passed with the same candidate:

* audio SHA `acf25b9ac68a11dc3f0fd193ec67283843e856a4a190a8e4cb2f35fcfa3df67c`;
* SRT SHA `af17d83246dedc55dbef5aa0ff2059461dd263415dac1ce32e7d993c007c3492`;
* 174 aligned words;
* evidence `/private/tmp/issue161-owner-clean.j8AcfU/word_timeline.worker-evidence.json`.

## 8. GUI truthfulness evidence

No Swift/UI behavior was refactored. Existing failed/cancelled display and
retry action remain intact. The bridge startup/re-entry path now invokes stale
reconciliation before exposing `recent-runs`, `run-status`, cancel, or retry;
the corresponding regression is `test_bridge_recent_runs_reconciles_stale_state_on_startup`.
The realistic cancellation probe observed `CANCELLED`, and the retry observed
`COMPLETED`; no stale spinner or false success remained in persisted state.

## 9. Resource budget and scope controls

One repair cycle was used (of two allowed). No speculative repair, owner test,
Astra escalation, GUI/Finder automation, merge, deployment, or cleanup was
performed. Existing recovery/reuse mechanisms were retained. The final
realistic retry required the existing local Whisper runtime and completed on a
fresh app-data root without an application restart.

## 10. Gate status and blocker

Headless syntax and diff checks passed:

```text
bash -n scripts/build_macos_app.sh scripts/test_macos_app.sh macos/Resources/bridge.py
git diff --check
```

The local full suite exposes two known GUI-producing packaging checks that are
not run as an automated recovery gate (`tests.test_macos_app` and
`tests.test_ready_app`), and three governance failures because the immutable
current-canonical baseline still names the pre-repair `bridge.py` bytes. The
validator correctly fails closed with:

```text
current canonical baseline hash differs: macos/Resources/bridge.py
R12 implementation hash differs: macos/Resources/bridge.py
R13 implementation hash differs: macos/Resources/bridge.py
```

Updating historical R12/R13 certification or weakening the self-integrity
validator is out of scope for this Recovery WP. Therefore GitHub Quality Gate
cannot honestly be claimed green on this branch; current status is
`BLOCKED`. A follow-up governed baseline-promotion step must bind the clean
candidate above to the current canonical baseline before owner handoff.

## 11. Owner-entry decision

`BLOCKED` — technical recovery and packaged evidence are green, but the
repository's fail-closed current-canonical governance gate is not yet promoted
for the changed `bridge.py` bytes. No owner was contacted.

all_pr_summaries.title: Wire controlled review and verified result export into macOS
all_pr_summaries.body:
Incremental delivery for #119 and Stage 2 of the runtime integration plan. This PR does not close #119 or claim general Knowledge Studio completion. The remaining V2-to-Canonical-Knowledge source-component limitation is explicit below; the implemented runtime paths are complete and test-backed.

## Working paths

- macOS results → explicit complete-TXT confirmation → pinned SeminarText Evidence Foundation, bound to exact source/TXT/timeline bytes.
- Actual topic drafts → versioned review package → explicit per-topic decisions, with no default semantic acceptance.
- Whole-segment topics use the actual canonical Knowledge compiler. Arbitrary word boundaries use actual V2 reviewed fragments, explicit inclusion/exclusion and boundary confirmation. Neither quotations nor Evidence are widened.
- Source playback at quotation start/end within the review window.
- Reviewed result → `build-reviewed-package` → immutable managed package → separate Obsidian or OneDrive preview and user-triggered publication. No automatic publication.
- The new `integra.reviewed_result_package` binds actual decisions, Evidence, drafts, result receipts, readable Markdown and exact upstream artifacts. V2 is never relabelled canonical.
- Validation checks cross-record meaning/ranges, not merely checksums. V1 additionally reruns the pinned compiler/renderer in an isolated temporary snapshot and compares every derived-view byte, coverage and unavailable source-resolver states.
- Existing staging, leases, collision protection, completion markers and legacy package contracts are reused. The UI now sends the selected publication destination; OneDrive wrapping/replay is deterministic and never claims cloud synchronization.
- Interrupted review recovery, unchanged-decision retries, legacy V1 metadata and concurrent source-output updates are preserved.

## Verification

- Full local supported suite: **520 tests PASS**, 278.692 seconds, including macOS launch/close and reproducible package checks.
- Dedicated reviewed-package tests: **13 PASS**, including rehashed decision, scope, disposition, Markdown, derived-note and coverage/resolver tampering.
- Focused bridge + destination-routing tests: **6 PASS**; legacy publication transports: **40 PASS**.
- Clean app: `build/review-publication-candidate/Integra.app`.
- Bundled bridge tests exercise both real V1 and V2 review → package → preview → publication to synthetic temporary Obsidian and OneDrive destinations, using macOS `/usr/bin/python3` and no source-checkout override.
- All **6 bundled bridge tests PASS** (10.391 seconds); native app `--self-test`: PASS.
- Governance validator and `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Independent runtime/package/transport review: all findings fixed and no remaining blockers.

## Limits and source impact

The pinned SeminarText compiler still requires complete BenchmarkSegments for Canonical Knowledge. Its V2 review workflow has no production consumer converting arbitrary exact fragments to Canonical Knowledge. Those fragments are nevertheless reviewable and exportable under their truthful distinct contract. No general concept/relation editor or full Knowledge Studio completion is claimed; #119 stays open.

The packaged review runtime requires a checked host Python 3.14; no OneDrive mount or source checkout is needed at runtime. V1 export verification uses that same pinned runtime. Exact source IDs/locators are preserved, but portable export does not claim source media is present on another machine.

No source-repository changes, user-media processing, live Vault/OneDrive publication, signing identity, notarization or release. The original cloud-blocked checkout and unrelated translation changes remain untouched. Scope: review adapters and export validator, native review/export UI and bridge, pinned packaging, associated state hashes, tests and review/recovery documentation. Interactive visual verification of the review modal/player has not been claimed.

See `docs/REVIEW_EVIDENCE_KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME.md`, `docs/REVIEWED_RESULT_PACKAGE_V1.md` and `docs/LOCAL_RECOVERY_2026_09_13.md` for the UI matrix, contract and recovery evidence.

pr.body:
References #187

## Scope

Documentation-only alignment with the Product Owner decisions of 2026-09-25.

- Keep Integra as the full-product base; use a proof-first VideoText-only Process direction.
- Russian source speech is the first completed Process journey. Full English-source ASR/alignment/topics may follow; all 47 MUST outcomes remain, including text translation, language choice, translated TXT and separate Topic translation.
- Prioritize Documents and Knowledge after Process, before full Studio.
- Distinguish integrated VideoText `2e098d1` from proposed 0.6.8 proof input `c4d851c`; newer fuzzy detection is not proven protective-retry equivalence.
- Record bounded sequencing, selected-runtime closure gaps, immutable result/provenance and Candidate-bound proof requirements.
- Keep the existing Process fallback and require separate authority before removing SeminarText. This documentation does not complete or close #187.

## Changed Documents

- `docs/PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_EXECUTION_INVENTORY.md`
- `docs/PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROOF_GATE.md`
- `docs/PROCESS_V1_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`
- `docs/INTEGRA_COMPLETION_PLAN_2026-09-13.md`

No product/runtime code, component pin, Completion Board status, CURRENT, Candidate, Gold or installed app changes.

## Verification

- Governance validator: PASS (`CURRENT_VALID`).
- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Independent read-only PR review: no material findings; closure wording corrected to `References #187`.
- Local full discovery initially ran 697 tests: two native packaging errors because this isolated clone lacks `.runtime-components`; 78 dependency-gated skips. Packaging stopped at prerequisites, not a completed app build. No app was installed or replaced.
- Local repository suite rerun with the two native packaging tests explicitly excluded: 697 discovered, 617 passed, 80 skipped (78 dependency gates plus the two explicit packaging exclusions), no failures/errors.
- GitHub Quality Gate runs the official governance validator and full supported `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` suite on Ubuntu for the new head. Its platform/runtime skips do not establish macOS Candidate or user-journey acceptance.

## Remaining Gate

#187 remains open until the full runtime-proof matrix is satisfied. PR #183 and PR #186 remain separate work; this PR does not merge, accept or deliver them. Technical proof, human acceptance, promotion and source-product retirement remain separate decisions.

pr.title: fix: govern disposable macOS build workspaces
pr.body:
## Product Owner bounded-retention decision implemented — 2026-09-30

Authority: [Issue #205 policy decision](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/issues/205#issuecomment-5917563905). Source HEAD `0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c`.

The prior request for a retention-policy decision is resolved: **8 full copies + 20 GiB managed attributed allocation + 15 GiB free after reservations**, with all owner-specified protected classes. This source implements ownership-bound admission/publication/cleanup, exhaustive canonical protection snapshots, exact protected survivor tuples, archive reuse, and durable crash recovery. Existing PR #206 supervision was reused. No historical archive deletion, CURRENT change, promotion, source-product modification or immutable original repair occurred.

### Verification

- Independent implementation review: **PASS**; **40 focused tests PASS** (24 retention + 16 canonical-governance mocks); 28 archive tests PASS.
- Full supported suite: **879 run / 786 passed / 92 skipped / one failed**. The governance regression rejects the changed native-builder hash until new exact source/Candidate evidence exists.
- Agent registration and diff check: PASS.
- Local exact-head governance: **FAIL_CLOSED**; previous Candidate/proposal is historical evidence, not evidence for this new source. Historical governance hashes were preserved.
- A fresh native source→Candidate evidence→declaration chain is required. It is blocked by the adopted archive caps and disk reserve in the actual historical state. **Do not merge/promote or infer owner Candidate acceptance from policy adoption.** Earlier successful Quality Gate runs apply to their old exact heads only.

### Historical migration dry-run (no actual cleanup)

| Metric | Bytes |
| --- | ---: |
| BEFORE_BYTES | 75,299,602,432 |
| PROTECTED_BYTES | 22,785,179,648 |
| DELETABLE_BYTES | 0 |
| UNKNOWN_BYTES | 52,514,422,784 |
| EXPECTED_AFTER_BYTES | 75,299,602,432 |
| EXPECTED_FREE_SPACE | 16,097,386,496 |

33 full copies exceed 8; 70.13 GiB exceeds 20 GiB. Protection is conservative pending exact survivor/pin reconciliation. All legacy publisher ownership remains unimported. The free estimate is the dry-run snapshot and assumes zero deletion; APFS exclusive reclaim is unproven.

Forensics resolved both inventory discrepancies as post-COMPLETE cache additions only; all recorded bytes matched. The existing a6d470/8be1ad recovery alternates freshly fully verify; unverified originals remain quarantined and forbidden for promotion. Writer remains unproven. Legacy unowned tmp/worktree/runtime copies remain preserved.

Exhaustive open-PR capture also protects old pending Candidates in #182/#183/#186, which are absent in the scoped archive. Along with #204/#206/#211, CURRENT, rollback and recovery, this yields nine protected identity roles before resolving a retained pilot pin; no protected Candidate is evicted to satisfy a cap.

### Separate historical Human Gate

Policy acceptance is complete. Before a nonempty historical migration plan can be generated, resolve exact rollback/recovery survivor paths, enumerate active provenance pins (including retained pilot2fe375), resolve missing old pending Candidates, and attest enumerated legacy ownership/terminal disposition. Actual bulk deletion requires the separate owner approval of an exact plan digest. The current strict plan is empty.

### Evidence

- [Implementation and 33-copy inventory](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/ISSUE_205_BOUNDED_RETENTION_IMPLEMENTATION.md)
- [Machine migration dry-run](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_BOUNDED_RETENTION_DRY_RUN_20260930.json)
- [Policy contract](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/BOUNDED_CANDIDATE_RETENTION.md)
- [Forensic proof](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/ISSUE_205_RETENTION_FORENSICS.md)
- [Independent review/source hashes](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/ISSUE_205_RETENTION_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW.md)
- [Test results and log hashes](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/blob/0dbf071b6a5fbded5cf8d95c86a2334dc02fe61c/docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_BOUNDED_TEST_RESULTS_20260930.json)

Issue #205 remains OPEN. Root cause is confirmed; the bounded implementation is not deployed while Candidate/Quality Gate and historical migration remain gated.

## Historical PR reports

The reports below are preserved history. Their old policy, head, Candidate and check outcomes do not describe the new source above.

## Latest forensic follow-up — 2026-09-30

Exact source `72fc6d37fede5fa3af7fd16934648b6e90120e85`; evidence overlay `1790a75`; declaration HEAD `073ad80bffe0ee6144bc96cf1a3c13ba606b5ceb`.
Local governance: PASS / CURRENT_VALID / PROPOSED_BASELINE_VALID / AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE. Exact-head GitHub Quality Gate: **PASS**, [run 36746585045](https://github.com/Yurielo/integra/actions/runs/36746585045). The earlier Linux failure at `6ad87d8` was repaired with a stable `/tmp` ledger outside child TMPDIR; macOS continues to use `/private/tmp`.

### Findings and repair

- Two pressure sources: legacy unowned tmp builds and unbounded permanent Candidate publication under the accepted PR #193 retention contract.
- Shared atomic disk admission now spans different workspace bases and archive staging on the same filesystem. Lock waits are bounded; live owners/children and unresolved roots remain reserved.
- Archive staging uses the common marked disposable lifecycle. Marker failure, post-spawn registration failure, cancellation and SIGKILL/retry across a changed archive ancestor are covered and repaired.
- Independent review PASS on exact source. Two simultaneous processes with different roots and insufficient budget for both yielded exactly one admission.
- Full supported suite: **839 tests, 747 passed, 92 skipped, zero failures**. Agent registration, diff check and governance PASS.
- Four sequential controlled full builds on the follow-up sources each produced verified archives and zero owned roots. Previous full concurrent-build measurements below are historical; new admission concurrency was tested with bounded synthetic processes.

### Archive audit and SAFE CLEANUP PLAN

The committed metadata inventory records 26 top-level COMPLETE Candidate archives / 14 bundle digests, plus retained historical Candidates and recovery/runtime/tmp copies; source commits and associated PRs, timestamps, sizes, receipt identities, and representative inode/link counts are recorded. No blanket payload hashing was performed. Final Candidate `c5f5b6ea7e8495c967c0b999dd24bdf7a3162c1fb34035cb0dcedbd5fe323cd2` and the cleanup-eligible legacy duplicate were byte-verified.

- `/private/tmp/integra-excel07-final-current`: nested app matches exact archived Candidate `136e1a5…`; archive independently reverified, bounded lsof found zero open rows. **About 2.12 GiB cleanup-eligible**, with a fresh no-writer check immediately before deletion; not deleted in this audit.
- Three other legacy full apps lack exact Candidate archives; preserve. `integra-excel22-topic-translation` remains open PR #204; preserve. The original legacy manifests bind old builder hash `ad81f7…` and September 29 timestamps.
- Repeated top-level bundle copies: **24.60 GiB logical upper bound** requires retention authority; digest equality alone does not authorize deletion. Two historical recovery app copies (~4.24 GiB allocated), and three recovery/review duplicates (~6.37 GiB allocated), also require a policy decision.
- Older runtime at `/Users/yurielokhin/AI/runtimes/integra/current-build` has no embedded Candidate manifest; preserve. User projects, Minecraft saves, installed/current apps and canonical archives were not changed.
- Four controlled source revisions added ~8.20 GiB logical app bytes (~8.5 GiB allocated) under the existing actual-byte retention requirement. This permanent growth is explicitly accounted for; no retained archive was pruned.
- Last Data free-space measurement: ~16.6 GiB. Earlier whole-volume find PIDs 9241/9275/9276 are no longer present.

Exact follow-up changed-file scope (12 files):
`docs/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_AUDIT.md`, `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_20260930.json`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE.json`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json`, `scripts/build_disk_admission.py`, `scripts/candidate_archive.py`, `scripts/temp_workspace_lifecycle.py`, `state/proposed_baseline_lite_v1.json`, `tests/test_build_disk_admission.py`, `tests/test_candidate_archive.py`, `tests/test_temp_workspace_lifecycle.py`.

### Human gate

PR #206 remains OPEN / AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE. No merge, acceptance, CURRENT promotion or deployment. **PRODUCT_OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED**: define protected canonical/review classes, explicit historical-review count/age bound and retirement authority, and decide whether equal verified bundles may reference shared immutable archive bytes while retaining per-Candidate metadata/evidence. No N, TTL or pruning policy was invented.

Evidence and class plan:
- `docs/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_AUDIT.md`
- `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md` (follow-up section)
- `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_20260930.json`
- renewed exact-source Candidate evidence/manifest and PROPOSED declaration.

## Historical initial repair report

The following text is the earlier snapshot; the follow-up above supersedes its current-state counts, Candidate, checks and process status.

Fixes #205. Related: #181, PR #183, and retained-Candidate policy from merged PR #193.

## Root cause and recurrence

The earlier owned-scratch fix did not cover direct Codex/manual calls to the low-level app builder, which created named `/private/tmp/integra-excel*` full Candidates without lifecycle ownership. PR #183 remains open, and this PR's broader guard was unmerged when the issue recurred. On 2026-09-30, `/private/tmp` occupied 24 GiB and Data had about 18 GiB free. Five stale copies had byte-verified permanent archives and no open users; only those exact five roots were deleted, recovering about 11 GiB. Five other full-size roots remain protected as UNKNOWN or an active PR worktree. The 53 GiB Build Archive at audit time is a separate retained-artifact pressure source; no archive was pruned.

## Repair

- The common disposable-workspace runner now forks a detached supervisor that owns the child process group and workspace. It detects killed/abandoned callers, handles SIGINT/SIGTERM and finite timeout, and removes the workspace on success or failure.
- The full Candidate wrapper uses that same lifecycle and enforces the documented 2.4 GiB expected size plus 2 GiB hard reserve.
- New runs conservatively reap only marked stale work. Live owners, unproven groups, other users' roots, retained archives, and source-product workspaces remain protected.
- Embedded runtime sharing and hard links were not introduced; Candidate and archive byte isolation remains unchanged. No SeminarText, VideoText, or BookText source repository was modified.

## Real macOS evidence

- Two sequential full Candidates, two concurrent full Candidates, failure, timeout, stale/live reaping, and release path all passed. Every scenario left zero owned roots and no owned descendants.
- Free before: 30.53 GB; after scenarios: 29.38 GB. The first build warmed caches; the second sequential build changed free space by only about 4.5 MB. Peak owned temp usage: 4.61 GB during concurrent builds; minimum free: 24.81 GB.
- Focused lifecycle tests: 11 passed. Final full suite: 830 run, 738 passed, 92 skipped, zero failures. Agent-team and `git diff --check`: PASS.
- A fresh full Candidate from exact repaired source commit `3ee6365` was archived and independently reverified: `candidate-v1-83a2fe1744d4ba79e2a0cb9321ee15a860a56216dc028d15bc4a0a724d731877`, bundle digest `dfa6b0102940534f2e06284a3768245d7476052bbe9f3e82713e1679b05a0204`.
- Governed sequence: source `3ee6365` → evidence `bd5d014`/`438e5d6` → declaration `324f9e9`. Local `scripts/validate_governance.py`: PASS, `CURRENT_VALID`, `PROPOSED_BASELINE_VALID / AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE`.
- Evidence: `docs/ISSUE_205_TEMP_WORKSPACE_AUDIT.md`, `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_REPEATED_BUILD_EVIDENCE_20260930.json`, and `docs/evidence/ISSUE_205_DISK_PEAK_20260930.json`.

## Remaining gates and limits

GitHub Quality Gate passed on exact head `324f9e9` (run 36730057135). The declared Candidate still awaits Product Owner acceptance under the repository's promotion contract. No CURRENT promotion or automatic release is claimed. The completed archive set (about 53 GiB before the new ~2.1 GiB Candidate) is protected by the accepted retention policy; pruning needs an explicit retention decision. The pre-existing root-owned whole-Data-volume `find` requires administrator authentication to stop. Four unarchived full-size temp Candidates/current/release copies remain UNKNOWN, and one full-size open-PR worktree remains ACTIVE; none were deleted. BookText/VideoText ad-hoc source-workflow roots remain governed by their follow-up issues (#53 and #4).

pr.title: Process plan: separate feasibility, integration and acceptance evidence
pr.body:
References #187

## Authority and scope

The Product Owner requested correction of the Integra plan following its critical review. Documentation only; this does not start runtime implementation or complete #187.

## Changes

- Align active Process DoD and proof plan: Stage A bounded feasibility, then Stage B integration and the full 47-MUST exit gate.
- Move minimal real dependency closure, versioned result mapping and single retry ownership before the first ASR proof; identify ProcessedSource as future implementation, not completed functionality.
- Require fresh VideoText execution without transcript/result cache, followed by a separate warm-reuse proof; preserve historical/user artifacts.
- Separate artificial loops, genuine spoken repeats, bounded retry, safe failure and successful recovery. Historical retry proof is not detector accuracy or guaranteed speech recovery.
- Require finite cases, attempt/time/repair budgets and comparison criteria before execution; distinguish long-media quality, compatible Gold, lifecycle faults, performance, full scope and repeated short-video E2E evidence.
- Specify derived-output invalidation and preservation of old human-reviewed versions.
- Describe a proposed first text-PDF-to-Knowledge journey after Process, without waiting for all OCR/Knowledge functions. Explicitly supersede the historical P7-after-P4 barrier for that bounded journey; semantic acceptance remains human-controlled.

## Exact changed-file scope

- `docs/PROCESS_V1_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`
- `docs/PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_PROOF_GATE.md`
- `docs/PROCESS_V1_VIDEOTEXT_ONLY_EXECUTION_INVENTORY.md`
- `docs/INTEGRA_COMPLETION_PLAN_2026-09-13.md`

No product code, Board statuses, component pins, CURRENT, Gold, user projects, installed apps or protected source repositories changed. Local companion plan was updated outside this repository and marked its previous sequence historical.

## Verification

- `python3 scripts/validate_governance.py`: PASS, CURRENT_VALID.
- `python3 scripts/check_agents.py`: PASS.
- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Local test discovery: 697 tests, 617 passed, 80 skipped, no errors/failures. Two native packaging/launch tests explicitly excluded for this docs-only task; 78 existing runtime-dependent skips. No app build/install/E2E was performed.
- Official GitHub Quality Gate must pass the full supported Ubuntu suite and governance checks for this exact head before merge. Runtime/platform skips are not app acceptance.
- Independent read-only reviewer: no material findings; all seven planning corrections addressed. PO role confirmed scope and retained authority boundaries.

## Remaining gates

Stage A evidence and its precise run limits/thresholds still need to be prepared before runtime work. First Documents/Knowledge format/examples are a proposed bounded future package, not newly accepted capability scope. #187 stays open until whole runtime proof, with user acceptance, promotion and SeminarText retirement remaining separate.
